project.label: The project
project.description: Twelve challenges a year, one a month. The list is fixed in January and written up as the year goes.

2025.title: First edition
2025.subtitle: A dozen challenges to give the year a rhythm.

daily-sport.title: Sport every day
daily-sport.note: A locked back mid-month broke the streak; I made the days up in February.

phone-time.title: Two hours of phone a day on average
phone-time.note: Went rather well, give or take a few slips.

fourteen-books.title: Fourteen books in the month
fourteen-books.note: Seven books read: Barjavel, Gogol, Benzine, Roux, da Empoli, Henn.

golden-arrow.title: Pass the Golden Arrow ski test

monte-cristo.title: The Monte-Cristo (5 km swim)
monte-cristo.note: The sea race was cancelled — 5 km in a pool instead, then views over the calanques.

chess-openings.title: Learn one chess opening a day
chess-openings.note: It was the holidays, you know how it goes.

rapid-rating.title: Climb to 1500 in rapid chess
rapid-rating.note: It was the holidays, you know how it goes.

two-hundred-kilometre-ride.title: 200 km by bike in one go

mediterranean-crossing.title: Cross the Mediterranean by boat
mediterranean-crossing.note: I will come back to it.

triathlon.title: Olympic-distance triathlon and beat my record

free-diving.title: 20 m free diving
free-diving.note: 10 m in the dive pit (the permitted maximum) ; 50 m dynamic alongside. Wonderful — and easier than expected.

montmartre-steps.title: The Montmartre steps a hundred times in one day
montmartre-steps.note: 4,300 m of climbing, green cap on.

italy-without-english.title: Go to Italy without using English

2026.title: Second edition
2026.subtitle: More structured. Fewer far-fetched challenges, more promises I can keep.

positivity.title: Positivity month — share something positive with the flatmates every day

early-nights.title: In bed at 11pm, lights out at 11.30pm (six days out of seven)
early-nights.note: Three weeks out of four. A real change of life ; good to wake up without an alarm.

pragma-dates.title: Find and book two gigs for Pragma

ten-hours-of-sport.title: Ten one-hour sport sessions in the same day
ten-hours-of-sport.note: At Les Pyramides with Arnoult and Matmat. Quite a day.

capes-maths.title: Qualify for the oral round of the maths CAPES

beat-the-metro.title: Beat the metro between two stations

weekly-strength.title: Three hours of strength training a week

metro-lines.title: Run every metro line in order within one month

backyard.title: Organise a backyard ultra and run it

daily-poem.title: One poem a day to a different person

montecristo.title: Finish the Montecristo
montecristo.note: A 5 km open-water swim in Marseille with Salomé. My neck was wrecked coming out.

half-marathon.title: Half marathon under 1h35
half-marathon.note: First attempt in early July: blew up in the heat. Target revised from 1h30 to 1h35 for the second attempt at the end of July.

catan-championship.title: Take part in the French Catan championship

lepin-under-six-hours.title: Under six hours at the Lépin Olympic distance

paris-dieppe.title: Paris–Dieppe by bike in one day, then a swim

three-thousand-pages.title: Three thousand pages read in the month
